note: Hand-maintained open-item register. Status updates are merged non-destructively: existing source leads, rights metadata, approved artwork and observations are never overwritten here. Not regenerated by any build script.

record.scope: Non-destructive intake annotation for the Nestlyzer handoff, not an application or source-register overwrite.
record.supplied_statement: Missing data: industry-cluster files (France, Netherlands, EU), rents, noise and land cover have no open source reachable from here yet. Coats of arms for the UK, Sweden, Norway, Poland and Brazil: no openly licensed artwork found.

prior_register_reference.name: Nestlyzer_Official_Data_Sources.csv
prior_register_reference.role: Existing leads only; not fresh verification of source availability or licences.

record.scoring_rule: Do not invent values, convert missing observations to zero, grant perfect scores for missing coverage, or treat estimates as measurements. This status annotation does not alter weights or scores.
